preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()[0:2])
preconditions.description: The first line contains exactly two integers n and m (3 ≤ n ≤ 150000, 0 ≤ m ≤ n*(n-1)/2).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next m lines contains exactly two distinct integers ai and bi (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ n, ai ≠ bi).

preconditions.expression: len(set(line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) == m
preconditions.description: No pair of members appears more than once in the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if all(not (x in friends and y in friends and z not in friends) for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(1, n+1) for z in range(1, n+1) if x != y and y != z and x != z and (x == friends[(y, z)] or y == friends[(x, z)] or z == friends[(x, y)])) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if and only if for every three distinct members (X, Y, Z), if X-Y and Y-Z are friends, then X-Z must also be friends. Here, `friends` is a set of tuples representing all friend pairs, and `n` is the number of members.
